title: Design System: EU JUST
description: A public legal register on warm paper: deep navy structure, one gold signal, Newsreader display type, Archivo interface text and IBM Plex Mono for docket references.

mono.usage: Kickers, case numbers, CELEX, dates, table headings, metadata labels

responsive.wideBehavior: Filters reduce to three columns and detail asides stop being sticky.
responsive.mediumBehavior: Record references move below the record body.
responsive.homeHeroBehavior: The paper home hero (copy and search left, framed photograph right) stacks at 1000px; below 600px the photograph moves above the copy.
responsive.narrowBehavior: The masthead wraps, forms become one column, and records collapse to a single readable column.
responsive.navBehavior: Below 900px the four research links and Operations menu collapse into one Menu disclosure.

masthead.behavior: Sticky translucent paper masthead. The four research sections are visible links; Monitoring and AI settings sit in a small Operations menu. Menus close on outside click and Escape.

input.focus: ink border plus a translucent gold ring

record-row.behavior: Date, title, subject, court and case number remain identifiable without hover.
record-row.hoverAccent: 3px gold inset rule; title underline draws in; arrow shifts
record-row.reference: IBM Plex Mono case number, Archivo court

source-box.behavior: Official source link and retrieval note are kept together.

status.behavior: Every state has a visible text label; colour never carries meaning alone.

home-hero.layout: Copy, search box and topic links left; supplied photograph right, framed with a 6px gold base rule.
home-hero.animation: rise on copy, wire-in on the photograph

ledger.behavior: Four real counts from the database (rulings, latest judgment, last feed check, monitored feeds); cells without data are omitted.

narrative.overview: EU JUST presents bounded, source-first European legal research on a calm paper surface. Deep navy carries structure and trust; gold and blue provide restrained signals; serif display headings add editorial character while Archivo keeps controls and metadata practical. The supplied EU flag photograph belongs to the home hero only.
productTruths: Official EUR-Lex and institutional documents outrank every product summary.
AI summaries are optional, clearly labelled and separate from source records.
Monitoring is bounded by configured topics, source windows and pagination; coverage is not exhaustive.
The site is research support and does not provide legal advice.

rules.name: Source before summary
rules.body: Keep the official document link, case metadata and retrieval status easy to find before any generated interpretation.

rules.name: Paper and navy structure
rules.body: Use warm paper for reading and deep navy for structural blocks; use gold and blue as restrained signals rather than decoration.

rules.name: Motion explains state
rules.body: Keep wire-in, hover, accordion and dropdown motion subtle, and collapse it under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: Readable legal records
rules.body: Show dates, case numbers, courts and official links in a predictable order with plain-language context.

dos: Use the supplied EU flag image on the home hero only and preserve attribution when it is supplied.
Make every page's purpose explicit before records or controls.
Keep official links one clear action away from every result.
Retain keyboard operation, visible focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Do not present AI interpretation as a court finding.
Do not invent records, statistics, testimonials or provider capabilities.
Do not resurrect the earlier black-and-red palette or an obsolete brand identity.
Do not use decorative gradients, glass effects or repeated hero imagery.
